_about: Read by scripts/guide-source-links.mjs. A host here is never asked (one reason each); a knownBroken address is accepted until its date, then reported again. 403 and 429 answers need no entry: they are never reported.

blockedHosts.reason: Answers 404 to any script, even for its home page, while every FTC link loaded in a real browser (checked 2026-11-15).

Resets every lychee connection (os error 54) in two runs on 2026-11-15, while the same page loaded (HTTP 200, 11 s) for curl with a browser agent: it drops the checker's TLS fingerprint, not the page.

knownBroken.reason: A correct DOI whose landing site vujs.vn has an expired TLS certificate (2026-11-15); the guide keeps the DOI. Look again on the date.
